sample.m4a, sample.ogg, sample.mp3, and sample.flac are copied unmodified
from github.com/dhowden/tag's own test fixtures (testdata/without_tags/);
sample.dsf, sample_tagged.mp3, and sample_tagged.flac from the same
project's testdata/with_tags/ (dhowden/tag has no without_tags DSF
fixture, and the existing tags on all three are useful for testing that
writing one field leaves the others alone). dhowden/tag is already a
direct dependency of this project — these are real, minimal, valid
containers of the exact formats writeTagLib needs to round-trip against,
which would otherwise be impractical to hand-build byte-for-byte.

sample.wav is copied unmodified from go.senan.xyz/taglib's own test
fixtures (testdata/eg.wav) — already a direct dependency of this project
(see go.mod), licensed LGPL-2.1 (full text: the module's own LICENSE file,
https://pkg.go.dev/go.senan.xyz/taglib?tab=licenses).

sample.opus is a local transcode of that same eg.wav, produced with
opus-tools' opusenc (`opusenc --bitrate 32 eg.wav sample.opus`) purely to
get a real, valid, minimal Ogg-Opus container for writeTagLib's Opus
round-trip test — not sourced from anywhere else.
